title: Blood returns from the body
hook: Trace one part of the circulation.

knows: The heart has atria and ventricles.
doesNotKnow: Systemic veins, including the venae cavae, return blood from the body to the right atrium.

misconception: Blood passes randomly between the four chambers.
objective: Trace the specified step in normal mammalian circulation.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: Blood returning from the body through the venae cavae enters which chamber first? Systemic veins, including the venae cavae, return blood from the body to the right atrium. The diagram is a simplified flow map, not the shape or scale of the heart and vessels.
